limits: Existing seven attempts on one fixed three-world campaign; model-family means are descriptive and do not estimate general failure rates.
All seven have NonZeroAgentExitCodeError and recorded EPIPE; six Opus/Sonnet attempts still reached campaign_complete.
Haiku zero is length-censored and must not be described as a completed reasoning/control failure; terminal home/alive comes from untouched rovers and verifier completion.
Scores use aggregate raw/max, not the unweighted mean of the three mission ratios. Official six-decimal Harbor scores are separately retained.
No single-world 2026, harsher-day task, one-request program or saved-program replay is included.
This extraction verifies retained arithmetic and provenance; it does not rerun the simulator, agents, Harbor or any new API call.
Recorded costs are Harbor-reported API estimates, not verified billing.
Fixed three-world campaign; no confidence interval or broader LLM superiority inferred.
Hybrid controllers use hand-written navigation; training/compute budgets differ from the historical LLM agents.
Replay latest policies have budgets8192,8192,2048; no seed or checkpoint selected by score.
